items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Marl Young; Interviewee responds with opinions about Marl Young's character and relationship with Estelle Edson, implying acquaintance but no direct personal interaction described.

ctx.x: I saw him in Atlantic City. Estelle Edson--you know--and Mel Moore--I used to see Estelle around Los Angeles a lot with Marl Young, they were good friends.

They were. I think they were engaged and I think Estelle told him-- of course, to each his own--but she just went overhead religiously so until--I don't know some kind of thought she was out of her mind, she was over everything, and of course, Marl was to the extreme the other way, some of them considered him an infidel.
